## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what prompted the change and what a user or contributor can do afterwards.

## Validation

List checks run, results and any unverified devices or networks. Include redacted screenshots for UI changes.

## Scope

- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private invitations, personal data or generated build output.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and privacy disclosures are updated.
- [ ] Evidence distinguishes local/simulated checks from physical-device and different-network acceptance.
